Synthetic Data Vault (SDV) Examples and Experiments GitHub Repository

This repository contains resources and examples related to Synthetic Data Vault (SDV), a Python library for synthesizing data. The examples are based on datasets from the UCI Machine Learning Repository and demonstrate how to use SDV to generate synthetic data that maintains the statistical properties of the original data.

Directory Structure

The repository is organized into the following directories:

  • SDV/
    • Example_adult/ - Contains the code for generating synthetic data using the "adult" dataset.
    • Example_hepatitis/ - Contains the code for generating synthetic data using the "hepatitis" dataset.
    • introduction/ - Contains introductory code examples and explanations of how to use SDV.

Installation

You can install the Synthetic Data Vault library via pip:

pip install sdv

This will automatically install all the dependencies the library needs.

Contributing

Contributions to this project are welcome! Please see the contribution guidelines for more information.

License

This project is licensed under the MIT license.

Contact

For any questions or feedback, please open an issue on GitHub or reach out to me via email at javier.molinarojas@alum.uca.es
